a.lede: SynthID Detector will flag content created with AI tools from OpenAI, Google, Apple and other companies.
a.title: Google's AI detection website is now available

b.lede: Google on Tuesday launched a new site that lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video, or an audio clip, is generated using AI.
b.title: Google’s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
